records.statement: If the Moon's domicile lord is not in the source's relevant positions, look to the second-house lord and judge by analogous separation.
preconditions: Fallback only after lunar house ruler method uninformative.

records.statement: Moon applying to eighth-house lord is offered as sign an animal has died.
preconditions: Historical author claim, no animal outcome independently confirmed.

records.statement: If no Moon-to-eighth aspect, her house ruler applying to eighth-house lord is another alleged death signal.
preconditions: Follow fallback order; alternative is not additive supporting outcome.

records.statement: If neither Moon nor lunar lord applies to eighth, infer from eighth lord's alternative positions by same method.
preconditions: Source's alternative is unspecific; retain uncertainty.

records.statement: Thief significator in ascendant, or transmitting virtue to Moon, or Moon transmitting virtue to it, is associated with a stolen missing thing.
preconditions: Role direction and original signifiers must be preserved.

records.statement: Ascendant lord and supposed thief significator applying by square/opposition is an adverse theft indicator.
preconditions: Hard aspects conditional on named lords, not any square.

records.statement: Moon's conjunction, square or opposition to thief significator or lords of Moon's house, term, second, Part of Fortune is part of theft checklist.
preconditions: Source list broad and glyphs copy-dependent; not every planet qualifies.

records.statement: Lack of those contacts is read as no theft, except when first/second, Moon's-house/term rulers, or Part-of-Fortune are unfortunate.
preconditions: Explicit exception prevents categorical innocence inference.

records.statement: For strayed beasts/fugitives/lost property, Moon applying to first or second lord or own dispositor is offered for recovery.
preconditions: This is a new general heading and combines three topic types.

records.statement: Moon in ascendant or Moon's dispositor in trine/sextile provides hope of recovery.
preconditions: Moon itself in first vs dispositor aspect are alternatives.

records.statement: Moon's house lord separated from 6th/8th/12th and applying to first or second ruler or degree of second is another favourable claim.
preconditions: Prior separation and next application both required.

records.statement: Moon afflicted by 6th/8th/12th lord is interpreted as lost property held by an ill person unwilling to surrender it.
preconditions: Source moral judgment not verified, do not identify suspect.

records.statement: Moon beholding Jupiter/Venus is said to mean an honest finder may return property.
preconditions: Specific benefic aspect and 17th-century description.

records.statement: Jupiter or Venus aspecting ascendant or Moon applying to first is read as property restored after difficulty.
preconditions: This sentence contrasts effortless vs painful restoration, qualifiers matter.

records.statement: Twelfth lord in twelfth or seventh lord in twelfth is claimed to mean fugitive imprisoned.
preconditions: Historic servitude/policing allegation, no verified custody data.

records.statement: Moon in tenth is read south, seventh west, fourth north, first east for direction of missing thing.
preconditions: House-angle directional convention, no coordinates.

records.statement: Lunar dispositor in a human sign is associated with a location frequented by people.
preconditions: Signs are traditional categories; not a search warrant.

records.statement: Moon or lunar dispositor in watery signs indicates water/wells; Moon in late Capricorn may indicate ships at a harbour.
preconditions: The late-Capricorn/harbour exception has local geographic caveat.

records.statement: Moon in fire sign indicates place near fire; Moon or dispositor in movable signs place newly developed.
preconditions: Separate fire-element and modality conditions.

records.statement: Moon within thirty degrees of first lord is taken to indicate missing beast near its owner, while a greater separation means farther.
preconditions: This formula is source-based, distinct from the p326–327 rule.

records.statement: Another planet separating from Moon's house lord suggests theft; Moon's house lord separating from another indicates wandering.
preconditions: This restates direction polarity from prior beast rule.

records.statement: Moon's dispositor applying to eighth lord is a claimed death or near-death condition for missing thing.
preconditions: Do not conflate lost inanimate object with creature death.

records.statement: Moon in ascendant or trine to first lord/Sun is included among source recovery indicators.
preconditions: Preserve exact planet glyph ambiguity in trine-to-Sun case.

records.statement: Second-house lord in ninth/tenth indicates goods with owner or trusted acquaintance rather than thief.
preconditions: Placement assigned to person category, not proof of actual holder.

records.statement: Sun in ascendant is associated with finding property, with source exception involving Aquarius-like/another glyph.
preconditions: Glyph and exception need independent review before deterministic encoding.

records.statement: An independent heading 'Of Beasts or Strayes' begins explicit livestock-house location scheme.
preconditions: Not another numbered chapter.

records.statement: Sixth-house ruler in sixth indicates small beasts; twelfth ruler in twelfth indicates larger beasts.
preconditions: Both conditions refer to respective beast category, not generic house size.

records.statement: Sixth lord in sixth/twelfth suggests animals in a pound, enclosure or official custody.
preconditions: Do not equate every sixth ruler in its domicile with captured animals outside this context.

records.statement: Sixth lord in fiery signs is assigned animals under fetters/locks.
preconditions: Old animal-custody inference, not real observation.

records.statement: Moon in common signs suggests rushy grounds; in an angle, fenced grounds; in succedent nearby/right hand; in cadent fields.
preconditions: These are alternative location settings, not simultaneous.

records.statement: Moon in Cancer/Aquarius/Pisces or other watery signs corresponds to rivers, pools, ponds; source gives zodiac-specific sublocations.
preconditions: The copy uses some sign glyphs without modern classifications; source-image parity needed.

records.statement: Moon in fiery sign indicates location near fire, airy sign open windows, earthy sign clay or mud walls.
preconditions: Element-to-place analogies, distinct from house-based direction.

records.statement: Moon or own house lord in movable sign indicates new buildings, hills or newly occupied ground.
preconditions: Location descriptions have many source alternatives; preserve specific glyph/house roles.

records.statement: Moon in fixed sign interpreted as flat/plain country; common sign near water.
preconditions: This contrasts with other references assigning fixed signs to hiding low places.
